forecasts.question: Will Netanyahu's coalition lose its Knesset majority or dissolve early before 2026-10-27?
forecasts.delta_reason: Retired OBE — Knesset dissolved July 17 by natural expiry (first full term since 1988); neither YES pathway (loss of majority, or early dissolution before Oct 27) can fire in a dissolved parliament. The question became operationally unanswerable the moment dissolution occurred.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a Knesset roll-call vote confirms coalition loss of majority (61 seats), OR if Netanyahu announces early dissolution and election date moves earlier than 2026-10-27. NO if coalition survives to mandatory election date with 61+ seats intact.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Knesset official record + Reuters/Haaretz/Times of Israel. Polling alone does not resolve.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If coalition drops below 61 but Netanyahu remains caretaker PM until election: YES. If a single party departs but coalition retains 61+: NO. Reviewed weekly only (Sundays); no intra-week deltas.

indicators.name: Smotrich formally departs coalition
Degel HaTorah files formal dissolution motion in Knesset

forecasts.question: Will Iran publicly commit to resuming mediated ceasefire negotiations (a named Iranian official or MFA announces readiness for talks) before EOD 2026-09-06?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-AMBIGUOUS. President Pezeshkian on September 1 issued a public conditional offer to resume talks 'if the US halts strikes,' cited by Reuters and Al Jazeera. Per ambiguity_rule: conditional or preconditioned offers = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO unless the US publicly accepted the condition, which it did not. Horizon passed EOD September 6 without a qualifying unconditional statement from FM Araghchi or the SNSC.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-09-06, a named Iranian official (FM Araghchi, Supreme National Security Council, or IRNA/Tasnim/Press TV quoting an official) issues a public statement committing to resuming or entering mediated ceasefire negotiations with the United States. A 'readiness for talks' declaration counts; mere written-message relay does NOT count.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: One TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP/Al Jazeera) citing the named Iranian official, OR Iranian state media (IRNA/Tasnim) carrying the official statement.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Conditional or preconditioned offers ('will talk if US stops strikes') = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO unless the US publicly accepts the condition; a mediator asserting Iran is 'open' without a named Iranian official statement = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

indicators.name: Araghchi or SNSC public statement committing to talks
Oman or Qatar mediator readout citing named Iranian acceptance

forecasts.question: Will a confirmed Iran-US indirect negotiating session (mediated, senior officials, named principals) occur before EOD 2026-09-17?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO. No TIER1-confirmed indirect negotiating session between named US and Iranian officials occurred before EOD September 17. Oman and Qatar conducted shuttle diplomacy and message relay but no convened session took place. Active US-Iran kinetic exchange through the period and Iran's stated 'no decision yet' posture precluded the conditions required by resolution criteria.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports a face-to-face or formally convened indirect negotiating session (not mere message relay) between named US and Iranian senior officials/envoys, hosted by a named mediator (Oman/Pakistan/Qatar/Switzerland), between 2026-09-03 and 2026-09-17.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 OR one TIER1 + official mediator readout.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Message relay through intermediaries without a convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. Trump assertions of 'semi-negotiating' without Iranian or mediator confirmation of a held session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

indicators.name: Oman/Qatar/Pakistan mediator readout of a convened session
Iran MFA confirms re-engagement or talks readiness
US-Iran bilateral halt in strikes for 72h+ (precondition)

forecasts.question: Will commercial shipping through the Strait of Hormuz reach >=30 vessels/day (7-day rolling average) before EOD 2026-10-03?
forecasts.delta_reason: Massive downward revision (−17pp). Straits.live AIS data (Sep 21) recorded the strait as effectively closed to commercial traffic with approximately 401 vessels holding in Persian Gulf anchorages. The IRGC-enforced restricted zone in the northern Hormuz approaches, activated September 7, remained in force as of September 22. Iran's Supreme National Security Council on September 20 issued a three-condition linkage — US strike halt, full sanctions lifting, written security guarantees — as explicit preconditions for any Hormuz transit normalization. With 11 days remaining to the October 3 horizon, reaching 30 commercial transits per day from near-zero requires a political breakthrough for which no current pathway exists. P floored at schema minimum 0.05. [Human review flagged: schema floor applied]
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if any AIS-based ship-tracking source (IMF PortWatch, Straits.live, MarineTraffic, Lloyd's List Intelligence) records >=30 commercial transits/day as a 7-day rolling average at any point between 2026-09-03 and 2026-10-03.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: AIS-based tracker + one TIER1 or OSINT confirmation (Bloomberg/Reuters/Lloyd's List).
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Naval escort vessels and warships do not count toward commercial transit; if trackers diverge by >20%, flag AMBIGUOUS. Dark transits (vessels with AIS off) do not count toward the 30-vessel threshold unless confirmed by named port-of-call arrival data.

forecasts.question: Will Likud win the most Knesset seats (seat plurality) in the October 27, 2026 Israeli election?
forecasts.delta_reason: Downward revision (−10pp). Polls conducted after the September 15 party-list closure deadline show Yashar (Eisenkot) leading in 4 of 5 published surveys with 24-25 seats against Likud's 21-23. A Channel 12 poll on September 20 recorded Yashar at 25 seats and Likud at 22 — the widest polling gap of the campaign. The security-vs-economy cleavage has continued to favor Yashar's centrist framing; Netanyahu's association with the ongoing Iran conflict has not produced the patriotic-rally consolidation effect his campaign sought. With 35 days to election day, Likud plurality chances reduced to 0.32.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if official Knesset election results published by the Israeli Central Elections Committee show Likud winning more seats than any other single party in the October 27, 2026 election.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Israeli Central Elections Committee official results, carried by Times of Israel/Haaretz/Reuters/AP.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If Likud and one other party tie on seats: AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO (no plurality). Exit polls alone do not resolve; official preliminary results suffice if published before EOD Oct 27.

forecasts.question: Will the current de facto fire pause between Israeli forces and IRGC-affiliated units in southern Lebanon survive intact (no resumed cross-border artillery exchange) through EOD 2026-09-30?
forecasts.delta_reason: New forecast. A de facto fire pause on the Lebanon front has held for 13 days as of September 22. UNIFIL reported no major cross-border incidents since September 9. Both sides have maintained deniability channels through French and UN intermediaries. The pause is operationally fragile — neither side has formally committed to it and IRGC resupply convoys have continued through the Bekaa corridor. The 8-day survival probability at 0.42 reflects the fragile but real holding pattern observed over the past two weeks.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if no TIER1-confirmed cross-border artillery or missile exchange occurs between Israeli forces and IRGC-affiliated units in southern Lebanon between 2026-09-22 and EOD 2026-09-30. Isolated small-arms or drone incidents below artillery-exchange threshold do not constitute a NO.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 sources (Reuters/AP/AFP) confirming a cross-border artillery or missile exchange, OR IDF/IRGC official statement confirming resumed fire.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: A single unconfirmed incident reported by only one party = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-YES until second TIER1 confirmation. Drone interceptions without retaliatory fire = YES (pause intact). An Israeli airstrike against a convoy in Lebanon not accompanied by IRGC return fire = YES.

indicators.name: UNIFIL reports no major cross-border incident in consecutive 48h windows
indicators.expected_effect: +5pp per additional 48h clean window; state will be updated daily

indicators.name: IRGC resupply convoy through Bekaa hit by Israeli airstrike with IRGC retaliation

forecasts.question: Will a named Iranian official and US official make confirmed direct or third-party-mediated contact (face-to-face or telephone) during UNGA high-level week (September 22-26, 2026)?
forecasts.delta_reason: New forecast. UNGA high-level week opened September 22 with both Iranian FM Araghchi and US Secretary of State Rubio present in New York. Under active kinetic exchange since September 1, conditions are uniquely adverse. Oman attempted to arrange a corridor meeting but Iran had not confirmed participation as of September 22 morning. P=0.10 reflects marginal but real UNGA-proximity opportunity.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports a confirmed direct or third-party-mediated contact between a named Iranian official (FM or deputy FM level or above) and a named US official (Secretary of State or NSA level or above) during September 22-26, 2026, on the margins of or within UNGA.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP) OR one TIER1 + official US State Department or Iranian MFA readout.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Passing acknowledgment or hallway encounter without a substantive exchange = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. Written messages delivered through a third party at UNGA without face-to-face or telephone contact = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.question: Will the US and Iran jointly announce a framework agreement governing Strait of Hormuz transit rights before EOD 2026-11-15?
forecasts.delta_reason: New forecast. Iran's September 20 SNSC statement issued a structured three-condition framework — US strike halt, full sanctions lifting, written security guarantees — as explicit preconditions for Hormuz normalization. This was the first time Iran framed conditions rather than delivering a blanket rejection, a marginal but real diplomatic development. The 54-day window includes the projected post-election Israeli government formation period and any UNGA momentum that emerges this week. P=0.16 reflects structural barriers (active kinetic exchange, Iranian domestic politics, Israeli election uncertainty) against a thin possibility that post-election Israeli coalition dynamics create a de-escalation window.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if US and Iranian officials jointly announce (in a single joint statement, or in same-day coordinated separate statements) a framework or roadmap governing commercial transit rights through the Strait of Hormuz before EOD 2026-11-15.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 plus official US State/CENTCOM and Iranian MFA statements required. TIER1-reported framework without official government confirmation on both sides = AMBIGUOUS.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Unilateral Iranian announcement of Hormuz access terms without US acknowledgment = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. A ceasefire agreement implying Hormuz reopening but not explicitly addressing transit rights = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

indicators.name: Iran SNSC publicly withdraws or modifies the September 20 three-condition linkage
US-Iran back-channel confirmed active at sub-ministerial level
Post-Oct-27 Israeli government formation proceeds without escalation trigger
